title: Ceramic Planter With Drainage Tray
description: A small plant pot with a proper drainage hole and a matching tray so water never pools at the roots. It looks tidy on a desk or windowsill and is much friendlier to plants than a closed decorative pot.
pros: Drainage hole prevents root rot;Tray catches excess water;Compact size for small spaces

title: Bamboo Desk Organizer With Phone Stand
description: A simple desk tray that keeps pens, cables and stationery in one place, while the slot at the back props up your phone. It clears clutter without taking up much desk space.
pros: Keeps cables and pens in one tray;Built-in phone slot for video calls;Natural bamboo finish
